featured_reviews.name: Rupali Malode
featured_reviews.review_text:
Subject: Warning to Investors: Systematic Mismanagement and False Promises
​I am writing this as a two-time investor with Sunteck Realty to warn others: Do not be fooled by the marketing. My experience across two different projects has been a series of broken commitments and zero accountability.
​Project 1: Sunteck Maxxworld (Naigaon)
Operational Negligence: My electricity bill has been incorrectly mapped to another flat since possession in April 2025. Despite 10+ months of follow-ups, Sunteck refuses to fix this.
Zero Accountability: Even after escalating to the grievance team and Mr. Sanjay Kumar Kanojia, there has been total radio silence.
​Missing Infrastructure: OC was obtained and maintenance handed over without basic necessities like Municipality water or a Sewage Treatment Plant (STP).
​​Project 2: Sunteck Beach Residences SBR (Vasai)
​Bait and Switch: The sales team promised a high-elevation beach view with 4 podium levels. Now, CRM (Chanda) confirms there is no podium and the view is primarily of the city.
​Lack of Transparency: When asked to put these revised plans in writing via email, the CRM team refused to commit.
​Don't be blinded by their fancy brochures. While investing they had shown the drone views and shared the snippet of the actual view which we would be getting from the flat. And now they are not commiting to the same view.
Dikhao pe na jao, apni akal ladao.
They take your money and stop responding. Save yourself the stress and be cautious before investing!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Rupali, 

Thank you for sharing your feedback. Regarding the concerns at Sunteck Maxxworld, our team is already working on the mentioned issues, and the matter is currently under review with the relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will hear back from us shortly with an update. With respect to Sunteck Beach Residences, project specifications and views are governed by approved plans and agreements. However, we understand your concerns and would like to review the matter in detail to address any gaps in communication or expectations. Our grievance team will get in touch with you within 2 business days to address the same. 

Regards, 
Team Sunteck Realty

featured_reviews.name: aayush ranka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall Experience
The villa provided an adequate stay; however, several maintenance and facility issues detract from the overall value proposition relative to the pricing.

Key Areas Requiring Attention
Climate Control
The absence of air conditioning in the common hall is a significant limitation, particularly during summer months
The bedroom air conditioning unit has insufficient cooling capacity for the room's dimensions, resulting in inadequate temperature regulation

Infrastructure & Facilities
Electrical switches and fixtures appear outdated (dating back to the 1990s) and require modernization
The refrigerator is not functioning properly
Pool maintenance is inadequate; chlorine levels require better management and upkeep

Positive Aspects
Third-party food delivery services (Zomato and Swiggy) function without issue

Recommendations for Improvement
To align the property with current market pricing standards, we recommend prioritizing:
Installation of air conditioning in the common hall
Comprehensive electrical system renovation and modernization
Full facility maintenance review (refrigeration, pool chemistry, and filtration systems)
General interior updates to reflect contemporary standards

In Summary: While the villa offers basic comfort, substantial renovations—particularly HVAC upgrades and electrical infrastructure modernization—are essential to justify the current pricing structure.

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your feedback - we genuinely appreciate it, and we're glad you found our house staff helpful! 🙏
We'd like to address a few of your concerns:
Regarding the pool: Chlorine is a standard disinfectant used in swimming pools everywhere to maintain hygiene and protect guests from bacteria. The levels we maintain are well within safe limits. That said, some individuals can have sensitive skin or a mild allergy to chlorine, which is completely understandable. We also want to gently remind guests that proper swimwear is mandatory in our pool - this is clearly mentioned in our pool rules. Regular clothing reacting with chlorinated water is unfortunately a common cause of skin irritation and fabric discolouration, which is precisely why this rule exists for everyone's comfort and safety.
Regarding the AC: We'd like to clarify that only one room experienced an air-conditioning issue during your stay - and as soon as our manager was informed, it was promptly attended to. We regret the inconvenience this caused.
We always strive to give our guests the best experience, and your feedback helps us improve. We hope to welcome you again for a more seamless stay!

Negatives were the mosquitoes and the need for better maintenance. 5 out of 6 electric points in one bedroom were not working. Water for bathing in the taps was only lukewarm. Parking space for 4 cars available.
